correctness.rationale: The proof handles the cyclic variation quotient exactly using positive/negative gradient transport into indicators of proper arcs. Every strict median-order chamber is a linear three-neighbor selector preserving constants; piecewise continuity extends its operator bound to all pairs. A selected arc has at most three output components, with a stronger two-component restriction for four and five vertices and zero for three. Constructive orderings realize every bound; explicit all-n data realize three for n>=7. The separate threshold/coarea proof establishes one-input contraction. Exact-integer code passed 5910 orderings, 37 attaining pairs and 8184 binary cases, used only as checks.

value.rationale: The all-n exact two-data BV modulus is a natural worst-case sensitivity invariant for a standard local nonlinear smoother. It distinguishes variation decrease on a single signal from threefold amplification of a perturbation, proves a uniform sharp constant and isolates its first attainable cycle length n=6. The single-arc extremizers and explicit small-cycle exceptions give reusable structural stability information rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
